summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state set/cleared in run_app's try/finally, invoke helper reused, active app set inside scheduled work) and added tests/test_concurrency.py with 9 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH=src. Caveat: the shared venv imports textual from base/src, which lacks the method, so PYTHONPATH=src is required. Full suite: 614 passed, 68 failed; the failures are from the venv lacking pytest-asyncio (async tests) plus tests/test_features.py:16, which I did not investigate. snapshot_tests, devtools and cli were not run (aiohttp missing). Nothing committed.
